question.text: The antiseptic action of Dettol is due to

solution.text: Chloroxylenol, also known as para-chloro-meta-xylenol (PCMX), is an antiseptic and disinfectant which is used for skin disinfection and cleaning surgical instruments. It is also used within a number of household disinfectants and wound cleaners. It is less effective than some other available agents. It is available as a liquid and sold with name Dettol.
